rawRecord.short_description: Service orchestration hub that enables discovery, composition, and authentication of multiple services through a single endpoint.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Operates as a service mesh where users can register services and connect agents through a unified hub with trust-level authentication and per-user OAuth passthrough. Supports multi-service workflows with sequential, parallel, and conditional chaining. Includes built-in integrations with Snowflake, weather data, financial market data, and browser automation, with JWKS-based token validation for secure cross-service operations.
